name: aident-loadout
description: Coordinate work across user-authorized apps with live schemas and approval-aware execution.

interface.longDescription: Aident Loadout helps users discover and run actions across services they authorize. It provides live action schemas, connection status, cost preflight, approval-aware execution, and reusable workflow guidance for multi-app tasks.
defaultPrompt: Find unread customer emails and prepare a sourced follow-up plan.
Research prospects and save the strongest matches to my connected CRM.
Review failed deployments and prepare a concise incident brief.
